components.text: Supply a substantive account of what Christian flourishing consists in.
Show that God contributes substantively rather than functioning as an irrelevant addition to human interests.
Connect the Christian account to practical cooperation, equality, peace, or concrete welfare outcomes.
The decisive demand is to show comparative practical benefits for life, cooperation, equality, and autonomy.
The additional demand is to explain how Christianity reliably resolves conflicting scriptural interpretations.
Show that presupposing logic without a further divine account makes secular reasoning false or defective.
Show that acknowledged presupposition amounts to a self-refuting intellectual foundation.
Explain how a secular reasoner can warrant the practical reliability of particular logical inferences.
The decisive demand is whether lacking an ultimate account of logic makes secular reasoning unjustified or defective.
Explain how fallible, physically realized brains can have access to logical truths rather than merely producing reactions.
Explain whether recognizing mind-independent logical truths supplies an ultimate foundation for their universality.
Answer the allegation that fallible cognition makes the secular position self-refuting.
The decisive demand is to explain how physically realized, fallible brains can access mind-independent logical truth.
A related demand is whether acknowledged cognitive fallibility makes the secular position self-refuting.
Provide a non-guaranteed but usable method for checking whether cognitive conclusions correspond to truth.
Justify the scientific checking process without relying on the very logical and empirical presuppositions under dispute.
Show that acknowledged fallibility does not make the secular method self-refuting.
The decisive demand is how fallible physical cognition can be tested for correspondence with truth.
A secondary demand concerns how scientific inquiry obtains warrant without certainty or self-validation.
Account for the universality and abstract character of the logical truths that individual brains recognize.
Show why practical presupposition is insufficient without an ultimate metaphysical account.
Show why independent corroboration cannot supply practical reliability without a universal mind.
The decisive demand is whether mind-independent universal logical truths require a universal mind as their foundation.
A related demand is whether practical presupposition can suffice without a metaphysical account.
A further demand is whether corroborated reliability answers the distinct origin or grounding question.
Clarify whether secular objective assessment requires absolute rules and explain the role of a specified value.
Show how value-relative objectivity compares with a revelation-based claim to objective authority.
Address whether objective normative assessments require a universal mind as their foundation.
The decisive demand is whether contextual ethics can make objective assessments without absolute rules or cultural subjectivity.
A related demand is whether objectivity uniquely requires an exceptionless revealed standard.
Determine whether secular humanism must explain logic's ultimate origin to function as a practical framework.
Answer the positive inference from universal abstract truths to a universal divine mind.
Explain how secular cognition reliably uses logic even if ultimate origin lies outside humanism's scope.
The decisive demand is whether secular humanism must explain logic's ultimate origin to function as a practical framework.
A related demand is whether using logic without a complete metaphysical genealogy defeats secular inquiry.
Justify human flourishing as the comparative goal without using the goal itself as its sole justification.
Show why comparative judgment still requires a non-question-begging justification of the governing interest standard.
Show that contextual consequence assessment cannot function unless its ultimate goal is independently grounded.
Address the distinction between objective assessment relative to a value and justification of that value.
The decisive demand is whether specifying a value makes objective assessment possible without circularly justifying that value.
A related demand is whether flourishing is independently justified as the comparative standard.
A further demand is whether contextual consequences can guide action without a justified governing goal.
Show that worldview comparison legitimately requires foundations for logic, science, ethics, and intelligibility.
Supply a nonarbitrary Christian ethical foundation that improves on value-relative assessment.
Show why merely presupposing logic is comparatively inadequate.
Explain why Christian foundations improve practical reasoning beyond independent corroboration.
Explain how Christian foundations resolve contradictory doctrinal conclusions in practice.
The decisive demand is whether ultimate foundations are required for comparative worldview conclusions despite the asserted narrower scope.
A related demand is whether Christianity offers a nonarbitrary ethical foundation beyond value-relative assessment.
A further demand is whether Christian foundations outperform practical corroboration in rational reliability.
A practical demand is to connect claimed foundations to demonstrated cooperation, equality, and peace outcomes.
